# Embedded snapshot Power Query sources

UTF-8 CSV snapshots are embedded in the draft so there is no machine-specific source path. Rebuild after rerunning analysis; native refresh reloads the embedded snapshot, not a live TLC feed.

## DimDate

```powerquery
let
    Source = Csv.Document(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    Nullable = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Nullable, {{"Date", type datetime}, {"Year", Int64.Type}, {"Month", Int64.Type}, {"YearMonth", type text}, {"Weekday", Int64.Type}, {"DayName", type text}, {"HolidayName", type text}, {"IsHoliday", type logical}, {"HasTripSource", type logical}}, "en-US")
in
    Typed
```
